description: Small hand-labeled synthetic calibration fixture; not representative of production memory or a held-out benchmark.

memories.content: The billing service stores invoices in PostgreSQL and uses SQL transactions.
Retry transient HTTP failures using exponential backoff and jitter.
A Redis cache keeps session tokens for fifteen minutes before expiration.
The Python package is built with maturin and a Rust extension using PyO3.
Validate the JWT signature and issuer before accepting an authenticated request.
Kafka consumers commit offsets only after successful message processing.
